title: KID TRAVIS returns with a new track "TAKE FROM ME"
htmlContent:
KID TRAVIS presents a new single called "TAKE FROM ME," that shines to the fullest, as his song writing and knack for making hits is amazing, riding the wave of this beat with ease, and displaying bravado of Rap’s biggest stars that make this a stand out hit for a stand out talent. He brings his signature super fly rap style and displays all of that in more on this production, that has a smooth feel that makes you chill, that his record making ability goes to work on with dope verses and a melodic hook you have to sing to.
